messages:
ana: Following the postmortem, I'm consolidating follow-ups for DR/resiliency. I'll own the tracker but need owners to confirm items and deliverable dates.
kevin: acked. please drop the list.
ana: (typo) meant ana. list below.
ana: paste: 
- routing reconciliation: root cause of stale route table entries after regional failover -> owner: kevin -> ETA: 10 days -> ticket: INC-1290
- periodic backup restore test: intermittent failures on snapshot restore -> owner: tony -> ETA: 7 days -> ticket: INC-1291
- partial-region DB restore steps: missing delta-apply step & cache warmup -> owner: meera -> ETA: 21 days -> ticket: INC-1292
- game-day runbook additions: add rollback templates, traffic verification checklist, and cross-team contact matrix -> owner: ops (devon) -> ETA: next rehearsal (2026-06-02) -> ticket: INC-1293
- incident recurrence analysis: collate last 6 months incidents and tag recurring patterns -> owner: ana -> ETA: 30 days -> ticket: INC-1294
kevin: I'll take routing reconciliation. initial hypothesis: control-plane retries cause duplicate reconciliations that leave stale BGP routes. will add metrics and a reconciler lock.
tony: taking backup restore tests. question: do we prefer full restores nightly or targeted smoke restores? propose smoke restores every night + full weekly.
meera: I'll author the partial-region DB steps. planning to include commands for WAL replay and cache rehydrate. will include exact timing windows and estimated downtime.
devon: ops here. will update the game-day runbook and include a pre-flight (traffic mirror + canary) procedure. rehearsal date 2026-06-02 works for oncall.
ops-bot: Link created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1290 | INC-1291 | INC-1292 | INC-1293 | INC-1294
ana: small ask: include rollback decision points and safe-timeouts in each runbook. we had a gap where teams hesitated to rollback.
kevin: noted. adding a timeout metric and explicit rollback step. will include a play to revert BGP announces if route convergence > 2m.
tony: adding a minimal smoke restore script to the ticket for review:
```
# smoke restore (s3-backed)
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/latest.tgz ./tmp && tar xzf ./tmp/latest.tgz
./scripts/restore --schema-only --limit=50
curl -fsS http://internal-health/restore-smoke || exit 1
```
meera: for DB delta replay I'll add commands and a verification query set. will also note dependency on replica lag < 1m.
ana: please add cross-team blockers in the tracker (network approvals, DBA windows). we'll have a 15m sync Thursday 11:00 to triage blockers.
devon: scheduling invites & rehearsal doc update. ops will also prepare pager matrix and escalation contacts.
kevin: instrumentation patch going into staging today; will promote to canary after tests. ETA 3 days.
tony: smoke restore infra wired up, running nightly tests. I'll post failures in the ticket.
ana: thanks. final: react with :white_check_mark: after you update your assigned ticket, and leave any PR links here for visibility. I'll close the loop after the Thursday sync. :spiral_calendar:
